Quote: 'Biola placed fifth of the nine teams.' 85.5 total points across 13 sports (6.58 average). Westmont won with 8.50. Behind Westmont, Concordia, Vanguard and The Master's.
Known only from the 2017 story: 'second year in a row that the Eagles finish second behind Westmont.' No 2015-16 standings page was found, so the points and school count are unknown.

110 total points across 14 sports (7.82 average; Vanguard also had 7.82 but is listed 3rd). Westmont won with 8.42. The story says this 'ties Biola's best-ever All-Sports Award finish.' Biola's last GSAC season.
